newsitem.title: USA: Etak settles copyright suit with Thomas Bros Maps.
newsitem.headline: Etak settles copyright suit with Thomas Bros Maps.

text.p: Thomas Bros Maps and said it settled a dispute with Etak Inc over copyright issues after examining Etak databases and determining they did not infringe on its intellectual property rights.
No damages were paid in the settlement, it said.
Sony Corp's U.S. unit agreed to buy Etak, a developer of digital map data, from News Corp last year.
Thomas Bros said it filed a lawsuit in October 1996 against G.M. Johnson & Associates Ltd and Etak alleging violations of its copyrights and trade dress rights.
At issue were four map books published by G.M. Johnson & Associates Ltd Thomas Bros said were created with digital data licensed from Etak Inc.

Etak, which Thomas Bros said denied all claims, reached a settlement with Thomas Bros after exchanging documents, the company said. The case with G.M. Johnson & Associates Ltd was still outstanding, it said.
